rows.text: September 7, 2006
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the benchmark call rate (uncollateralized overnight rate) at its current level (4.50%) for the intermeeting period.
(The following is an unofficial English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision
In the real economy, exports continue to exhibit steady growth, facilities investment maintains its pace of growth.
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the benchmark call rate (uncollateralized overnight rate) at its current level (4.50%) for the intermeeting period.
On the other hand, private consumption has temporarily exhibited some degree of adjustment and construction investment shows lackluster movements.
Meanwhile, the current account has suffered a deficit, owing to the narrowed goods account surplus and widened services account deficit.
(The following is an unofficial English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
In the real economy, exports continue to exhibit steady growth, facilities investment maintains its pace of growth.
Both consumer price inflation and core inflation maintain overall stability.
Nevertheless, inflation pressures persist due to economic recovery and high oil prices.
On the other hand, private consumption has temporarily exhibited some degree of adjustment and construction investment shows lackluster movements.
Meanwhile, the current account has suffered a deficit, owing to the narrowed goods account surplus and widened services account deficit.
The upward pace of real estate prices has slowed down.
Both consumer price inflation and core inflation maintain overall stability.
In the financial markets, overall liquidity conditions are favorable and financial institutions' lending has slowed the pace of its expansion.

Taking the above economic and financial conditions into consideration, the Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the benchmark call rate (uncollateralized overnight rate) at its current level (4.50%) for the intermeeting period.
